observations:
1) ENTRY rule fits all 7 originals exactly: the trigger bar closes beyond the extreme of the preceding few bars, and the limit is the more conservative (closer to the trigger close) of the trigger-bar body mid and that broken level. LONG entry = max(body mid, highest high of the prior bars that the trigger close broke): 04:40 4165.9 (mid 4165.9 = 04:15 H), 07:30 4199.4 (07:20 H > mid 4198.25), 11:20 4221.4 (mid > prior H 4217.5), 20:55 4214.3 (20:45 H > mid 4213.9), Mon 05:55 4234.3 (05:40 H > mid 4231.55). SHORT entry = min(body mid, lowest prior low): 18:25 4198.95 (mid; 18:15 L 4201), Mon 10:35 4217.4 (mid; 10:25 L 4217.7). Trigger bodies can be small (0.57-0.78 ATR on 04:35, 07:25, 20:50, 10:30), so the trigger is not a large-candle filter.
2) STOP: 6 of 7 stops are 1.80 x ATR14 (Wilder/RMA, measured at the trigger bar; R/ATR 1.79-1.81). The exception is the Fri 18:25 short: the stop is 4203.6 = the 18:20 trigger-bar HIGH (pixel-measured 4203.59 from the frame; the TP1/TP2 lines confirm R 4.65-4.68; the VWAP line is 6 px higher at 4204.0). That is 1.06 ATR, against the 1.8-ATR stop of 4206.85. A rule like 'cap at the trigger extreme when it lies between the entry and the ATR stop' does NOT hold for the longs: 11:00 low 4217.1 and 05:50 low 4228 would have capped those stops, but the original used the full 1.8 ATR. The only special feature of 18:20 is that it is the bar that crossed VWAP (18:15 close 4203.7 just under VWAP 4204.18, 18:20 open 4203.5 / close 4194.4) and it was the first short of the day after only longs. Treat it as a VWAP-cross case to investigate, not a general cap.
3) FILLS/CAP = 5 per model day. Original Friday fills: 04:40, 07:30, 11:20, 18:25, 20:55, which is exactly 5. Mine reached 5 by 12:35 (extra 03:40, 05:35 and 12:35), so it missed 18:25 and 20:55 (cc0d7275 has no boxes in the evening). That missing 20:55 long changed Monday as well: the original held it over the weekend (stop never hit) to TP4 at Mon 05:40, so it could not take the Mon 03:35 short that mine took while flat. Removing the extra Friday trades should fix all four of these differences.
4) Skipped triggers: (a) Fri 03:35, the 2nd bar of the session, closed above the single 03:30 bar (body 2.9 = 1.19 ATR, close 1.9 above the just-reset VWAP): no trade. Mon 03:30, the first bar (body -7.7 = 3.1 ATR): no trade, but the original was in a position then anyway. The original seems to need some minimum number of bars in the session before a level/trigger is valid. (b) Fri 05:30: the original took TP4 on this bar, and the bar is itself a breakout (close 4172.8, body 1.31 ATR); it did not re-enter (mine filled 05:35). So there is no trigger on the bar where the previous trade exits, or a cooldown. (c) Fri 12:30, 40 min after the 11:50 stop: body only 0.37 ATR, close 4222.1 above the 12:25 H 4221.7 but below the 11:35 H 4224 (11 bars back). The original did not trade; mine filled 12:35. This suggests the original's breakout lookback is longer than about 10 bars, or it needs more body.
5) Accounting: MODEL DAY counts trades by exit day. Monday's 2W/1L +3.00R = Fri 20:55 long closed TP4 on Mon (+2R) + Mon 05:55 long stopped (-1R) + Mon 10:35 short TP4 (+2R), while FILLS counts only Monday fills (2/5). Every frame read (126bd692, 4772dc3c, 1c019e4f) shows this same table, so the table is the state at recording time (Mon ~13:00), not at the crosshair.
6) Exits: TP4 = entry +/- 2R, stop = entry -/+ R, checked with bar highs/lows. The bar that touches the level closes the trade, and the box ends on that bar (05:30, 10:45, 11:50, 18:30, Mon 05:40, 07:05, 11:00). Positions carry across the weekend session gap.
7) Orig 13b3c576 has blue circle markers (not trades) at body mid of Fri 11:35 (in-trade) and 13:15 bars.
8) Where trades match (07:30, 11:20, Mon 05:55, Mon 10:35), my entries and stops agree within 0.1 (axis precision).
